name: Valentine Panic!
source:
You need a job and fast. However, every job to apply for seems to not have any positions available to you. Before you give up, you find luck in the Pink Lady Cafe, working a full-time job for Valentine's Day. Simple, right?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/valentine-panic]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你需要尽快找到一份工作。然而，每份申请似乎都没有适合你的空缺。在放弃之前，你幸运地在Pink Lady咖啡馆找到了一份情人节全职工作。

很简单，对吧？

（来源：[url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/valentine-panic]itch.io[/url]）
